_comment: Per-sample QC cutoffs, read by 01_qc.py (preview) and 02_qc_apply.py (apply).
A spot is DROPPED when it fails any of its sample's cuts:
n_genes_by_counts <= min_genes,  total_counts <= min_counts,  pct_counts_mt >= max_pct_mt
Precedence: built-in fallback -> this file's 'default' -> CLI flags -> this file's 'per_sample'.
A sample listed under per_sample ignores the CLI flags: edit its entry here instead.
Omit any key inside a per_sample entry to inherit it from 'default'.
Re-run `pixi run qc` after editing to see the consequences before applying.
_derivation: Set 2026-08-06 under a hard constraint: DROP AT MOST 10% OF SPOTS PER SAMPLE.
Each sample's cut is therefore the largest threshold whose union drop
(counts OR genes OR mito) still fits under 10% of that sample - derived from
the sample's own quantiles, walking observed values because counts are
discrete with heavy ties at 1-5 UMIs (a plain 10th-percentile call overshoots).
Realised drop per sample: TIS05393 9.98%, TIS05394 9.93%, TIS04789 8.95%,
TIS04788 8.61%, TIS05397 7.24%, TIS05392 6.12%. Overall 91.9% of spots kept.
CONSEQUENCE, on the record: the 10% cap binds well below the distribution
structure on the four weaker captures. TIS05397 / TIS04788 / TIS04789 /
TIS05392 are bimodal (a near-empty mode at 4-19 UMIs and a tissue mode at
113-992), and the valley between those modes sits at 40-131 counts - far
above what a 10% budget allows. Cutting at 0-4 counts keeps the near-empty
mode almost entirely: median counts among KEPT spots is 7 (TIS05392),
16 (TIS04788) and 25 (TIS05397), against 302 and 170 for the two good
captures. Those spots carry little signal and will still be clustered,
The previous mode-based cutoffs are preserved in git history if the cap is
ever relaxed; see 01_qc_overview.pdf (histogram row) for the mode structure.

TIS05393._note: unimodal capture; the cap is the binding constraint, drops 9.98%

TIS05394._note: unimodal capture; the cap is the binding constraint, drops 9.93%

TIS05397._note: bimodal, valley at 131; cap allows only 4 -> drops 7.24%, near-empty mode retained

TIS04788._note: bimodal, valley at 88; cap allows only 2 -> drops 8.61%, near-empty mode retained

TIS04789._note: weakly bimodal, valley at 58; cap allows only 4 -> drops 8.95%

TIS05392._note: no threshold above 0 fits the cap (>10% of spots sit at 1 UMI); drops 6.12%, i.e. zero-count spots and mito outliers only
